definitional_reflexivity.rationale: All reduce to reflexivity using the left-recursive definition of addition; includes definitionally equal statements 001/002 and 005/006.

premise_reuse.rationale: Direct reuse of an equality premise, including reversing its orientation.

premise_congruence.rationale: Transport n = m through successor/addition contexts, including repeated occurrences and either rewrite direction.

premise_definitional_substitution.rationale: Substitute a constructor-headed equality premise to expose a defining clause of addition. Keep the entire equality_transport split group together, including congruence and direct-reuse relatives.

right_zero_variants.rationale: Right-zero induction and its repeated, contextual, and premise-conditioned variants. The existing examples/add_zero_right.json belongs with this family.

successor_reassociation_variants.rationale: Right-successor, increment, contextual, and reassociation variants are linked by seed 030, which combines successor reasoning with associativity and specializes to 025 at m = 0. Keep their connected family together. Includes definitionally equal statements 017/022 and 018/026.

conditional_permutation.rationale: Lift a given commuting equality under an arbitrary common prefix using induction.
